summary: Michael Devine’s retained-pair bound uses Kristian Muri Knausgård’s quartic window. ajp88 first re-optimized the shift for this bound and reported a 100-decimal floor. We sharpen the shift and the rational floor together. With the same window and pair certificate, the gain over ajp88 is approximately 9.314 × 10⁻⁹⁹ percentage points. The Lean proof establishes the submitted exact rational in both required intervals under the board’s RH premise.
method: Exact rational optimization of the retained-pair shift with the board’s 200-digit limit
model: OpenAI GPT-6.2 Astra (optimization); earlier proof credits in the source
